description: This file is a shell script for testing Git's rename detection capabilities, particularly with symbolic links and copy operations. It sets up test cases, runs diffs, and validates the output for expected rename and copy behavior.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case with a description and a block of commands to execute for setup or validation.

methods.name: git update-index
methods.description: Updates the Git index with specified files, adding or removing as needed.

methods.name: git write-tree
methods.description: Creates a tree object from the current index state, returning its hash.

methods.name: git diff-index
methods.description: Outputs diff of the index against a tree object, with options for rename and copy detection.

methods.name: compare_diff_patch
methods.description: Compares the current diff output to an expected diff patch for validation.
